text: by the Scriptures that it was no more expediant to observe the law of Moses now in thisthing they did err haveing not understood the Scriptures but it came to pass thatthey soon became converted & were convinsed of the error which they were in for it wasmade known unto them that the law was not yet fulfiled & that it must be fulfiled inevery whit yea the word came unto them that it must be fulfiled yea that one jotnor tittle should not pass away till it should all be fulfiled therefore in this sameyear were they brought to a Knowledge of their error & did confess their faults & thusthe ninety & second year did pass away bringing glad tidings unto the People becauseof the Signs which did come to pass according to the words of the Prophesy ofall the holy Prophets & it came to pass that the ninety & third year did also pass
